params.name: certifRequest
params.description: BLOB receiving the generated certificate request

params.name: codeArray
params.description: Information code list -- confirmed an array (not a scalar Integer) by the doc syntax line 'codeArray : Integer array', synchronized element-for-element with nameArray.

params.name: nameArray
params.description: Name list -- confirmed an array (not a scalar Text) by the doc syntax line 'nameArray : Text array', synchronized element-for-element with codeArray.

overloads.semanticRole: Generates, in certifRequest, a PKCS-format certificate request built from privKey and the code/name identity arrays, for submission to a certificate authority.

constraints: The generated request is in PKCS format, suitable for submission directly to a certificate authority (e.g. Verisign).
